title: A new GTA 6 leak shows Lucia robbing an ATM and parachuting off a roof - naked
summary: GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek has posted a new five-minute video of Lucia in Leonida, including an ATM mugging, hand-to-hand combat, and a naked parachute jump.

Image credit: Rockstar Games News by Vikki Blake Contributor Published on Oct. 11, 2026, 12:27 p.m. 7 comments Follow Grand Theft Auto VI Prioritise us on Google GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is back with another video, this time with a naked Lucia taking a parachute jump off a rooftop. The five-minute clip was posted on ResetEra a few days after CyberLeek's 25-minute video of Jason , and a day after the leaker threatened to release a full playable build . Note: there are some mild spoilers pertaining to what you might do in GTA 6 below. To see this content please enable targeting cookies. Manage cookie settings GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Extended Gameplay. Watch on YouTube The video - which I'm afraid I'm not going to post here - reportedly opens with CyberLeek driving through Vice City in a black-and-white car, before Lucia gets out in nowt but her birthday suit. As with Jason, nobody reacts to her, and as we noted last time, whoever is playing seems to have access to a dev menu, which means a naked Lucia could be a debug feature rather than something you'll be able to do in the open world. Lucia then heads up some stairs to an ATM, where she beats up a passer-by and takes their money. The machine shows a $15,000 limit and a Buckme logo (thanks, TheGamer ). She goes into a nearby building, where a construction worker asks if she's with the guy on the roof, and takes the elevator after a short exchange. Following a phone call, she makes her way to the roof and is handed a parachute before jumping off. CyberLeek isn't a natural at that part of the game. The first jump drifts well off course and ends in a crash into a building, while the second gets closer to the target but sails past the landing point. The video also includes an in-game ad for Buckme. CyberLeek has said they'll release the full build if their cryptocurrency coin reaches a market cap of $30 million . Rockstar has previously issued statements regarding the leaker, noting that the leaks are "heartbreaking" and that "this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time". Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company, has been hunting for the person behind the leaks, and has tried to subpoena Discord for information pertaining to the leaker's identity. GTA 6 is due out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on 19th November.
